name: dataverse-modelling-mcp
description: Local C# MCP server for modelling Dataverse: tables, columns, views, classic workflows, business process flows, cloud flows and command bar buttons. Plugin, binary and tool versions are identical; on every server start the launcher brings the binary to the version pinned in scripts/BINARY_VERSION.

dataverse_url.title: Dataverse Environment URL
dataverse_url.description: e.g. https://yourorg.crm4.dynamics.com — the URL of the Dataverse environment to model against.

client_id.title: Azure AD Application (Client) ID
client_id.description: App registration with Dataverse permission. Stored in the OS keychain.

tenant_id.title: Azure AD Tenant ID
tenant_id.description: Optional. Default: the tenant of the plugin environment.

release_repo.title: Release repository for the binary
release_repo.description: GitHub repository with the release assets, e.g. 'hydr/dataverse-modelling-mcp'. The default is usually right.
